title: the prince
medium: Portrait AI on Roman mosaic. Animation, video, watercolors, hue regeneration, software on computer. Hours, minutes, tides, and lunar/solar phases predicted. Touch-enabled. Original image AD 200, from a villa at Daphne near Antioch (modern Antakya, Turkey). Courtesy of the Princeton University Art Museum. Edition of 5 with 2 APs. 24-hour videos, edition of 30. Unique prints.
